verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no mention of winget, Windows Package Manager, Dev Home, or any single-command bootstrap for installing packages/tools/runtimes; it only covers app development frameworks (WinUI, Windows App SDK) and PowerShell as a scripting CLI, none of which describe a one-command full dev environment setup. missing for 10: evidence of winget/package manager, evidence of a documented single-command install of packages/tools/runtimes, any dev-environment bootstrap tool.
